summary: Iteration 3 retest after iteration_2 critical UI bug fix in EvaluationView.jsx. ALL frontend flows now work end-to-end. The whitescreen bug is fully resolved — Button/Copy/toast imports were added and TalkRatio + TranscriptViewer are now imported and rendered between Score Breakdown and Compliance/Process. Backend was not retested (no changes since iteration_2 where 20/20 pytest tests passed).

issues: Load sample fills the transcript but leaves the AGENT NAME field blank, so the resulting evaluation appears in History/Leaderboard as 'Unknown Agent'. Not blocking, but a small UX gap — consider auto-filling a sample agent name like 'Sarah Khan' when 'Load sample' is clicked.

talk-ratio-card visible with talk-ratio-bar; '47.1% / 52.9%' badge 'On-target'; word counts 'Agent 41 words / Customer 46 words'
transcript-viewer visible with 9 turn-* bubbles (5 agent in blue, 4 customer in zinc) — diarization rendered correctly

Analyzer tab -> auto-label-btn on raw 4-line transcript -> textarea updated to 'Agent: ... / Customer: ...' prefixed text after ~2-3s LLM call
action_items: OPTIONAL: 'Load sample' should also pre-populate agent name input (currently leaves it empty -> evaluations show as 'Unknown Agent').
OPTIONAL CLEANUP: Leftover TEST_E2E_Agent entry from iteration_2 retest is at top of leaderboard with score 56. Main agent may want to delete it from MongoDB if production data is desired clean.
critical_code_review_comments: EvaluationView.jsx now correctly imports Button, Copy (lucide), toast (sonner), TalkRatio, TranscriptViewer — fix verified.
TalkRatio.jsx: returns null when both agent_words and customer_words are 0 — graceful fallback OK.

TranscriptViewer.jsx parseLines() regex matches 'agent|customer|rep|representative|caller|client|cust' prefixes — handles common aliases. Unlabeled lines are appended to the previous turn or marked as 'unknown' — sane behavior.
Recommend enabling ESLint rule 'react/jsx-no-undef' (or import/no-unresolved) in CRA config so the Button-not-imported regression caught in iteration_2 is caught at lint time in future.
seed_data_creation: One new evaluation created during retest via 'Load sample' -> Analyze Call (Unknown Agent, score 12, 5/8/2026 4:17 PM). Plus the iteration_2 TEST_E2E_Agent entry still present in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration_2 critical bugs are fixed and verified. Both EvaluationView import bug (Button/Copy/toast) and the missing TalkRatio/TranscriptViewer wiring are resolved. App is fully functional end-to-end. Backend was not retested because no backend changes were made; the 20-test pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_bpo_qa.py + test_new_features.py is the regression baseline.
